label: Heavy Rain
summary: Heavy rain can overwhelm drains and sewers, causing water to rise quickly in streets, basements, and other low places.

items.label: Know where you can go above ground
items.body: If you live in a basement, move early when flooding is forecast or warned.

items.label: Never walk or drive through floodwater
items.body: Stay away from downed wires and flooded electrical equipment.

items.label: Keep exits clear and essentials ready
items.body: Follow local alerts; report damage to 311 after you are safe.

items.label: Trapped by rising water or facing immediate danger?
Learn what to do before and after flooding
items.body: Flood safety, basement precautions, and recovery steps.

items.label: Check rainfall flooding risks
items.body: Links to stormwater flood maps and ways to protect your home. Maps are planning tools, not live warnings.

items.label: Understand flood insurance and home protection
items.body: A nonprofit resource: flood risk, separate flood insurance, and home improvements. Program eligibility varies. Website in nine languages.

items.label: Explore ways to keep water out
items.body: A private NYC platform: property improvements and local providers. Work may cost money; compare providers independently.

items.label: Find practical rainfall preparation steps
items.body: From DEP. Prepare drains, property, and household plans before intense rain.

items.label: See water levels at nearby flood sensors
items.body: Near-real-time readings at sensor locations. Coverage is limited; a blank map does not mean a street is safe.

items.label: Clean up safely after a flood
items.body: Safe cleanup, food and water safety, and steps to reduce mold.

items.label: Get guidance on mold and dampness
items.body: Preventing and removing mold. Tenants can report unresolved conditions through 311. Translated mold guide.

items.label: Report a sewer backup
items.body: Report sewage flooding in a building. Call 911 if floodwater creates immediate danger.

items.label: Get help if you cannot return home
items.body: Help for tenants displaced by emergencies or vacate orders. Call 212-389-6670.
